name: r2-skinny
levers: G10 (dense:D3) skinny_mx v2 for the qkv_a shard
G09 part D2 (dense:D2) MXFP8 quant fused into the skinny qkv_a prologue

flags.name: DSV41_SKINNY_V2
flags.meaning: G10: qkv_a shard GEMV through skinny_mx_v2_ext.so (same per-output op order as skinny_mx_ext.so, latency-restructured); pdl = launched with programmatic stream serialization so its weight loads overlap the producer's tail. Per-layer, per-M bitwise self-check against the live chain at the first eager build; any mismatching M stays on the live kernel.

flags.name: DSV41_SKINNY_QFUSE
flags.meaning: G09/D2 (needs DSV41_SKINNY_V2=1|pdl): the qkv_a input MXFP8 quant (MXFP8QuantizeSwizzled grid 128 x 640) is done inside the v2 prologue with FlashInfer's op sequence; the quant kernel disappears. Self-checked byte for byte against the live quant (also pins the FTZ mode of amax*(1/448)); mismatch -> stays off.

flags.name: DSV41_SKINNY_V2_GRID
flags.meaning: v2 grid; 0 = #SMs like v1. Exact for any grid with ceil(224/grid) <= 8.

flags.name: DSV41_SKINNY_V2_CHECK
flags.meaning: 0 skips the build-time bitwise self-check; never in serving
